reading_notes.global: Extract every record in this document type's checklist, including repeats. One table row or one goal is one record. Quote the source text that holds the record; every quoted field value must appear in that quote. Do not infer absent numbers, identities, relationships or legal conclusions. Report a labelled but empty field as field_present_but_empty, citing the label. Distinguish what is observed, planned and decided.

by_document_type.iep.plan: Session length is not duration: '30 minutes, 2 times a week' is minutes per session and sessions per period; duration is start and end dates. When a service states an explicit total such as '150 minutes weekly', put that phrase in frequency_text; do not split it into minutes per session. Quote each service row whole. Keep the meeting date and the IEP start date apart. In present levels, one measurement per score with its measure fields; never merge accuracy percentages with words correct per minute. Split a goal's target value and accuracy criterion into separate fields. Record Oral Reading Fluency and reading fluency as the task reading fluency.
by_document_type.iep.amendment: Record the date of the IEP being amended. Extract only the records the amendment changes or adds, plus one amendment_change per affected section.
by_document_type.iep.progress: One progress_entry per goal per reporting period. Quote progress codes as written and choose the status code from the list. Emit each reported score as a measurement with context progress_report.
by_document_type.iep.evaluation.academic: One measurement per reported score, with instrument, subtest as task, and score type. Record the administration date.
by_document_type.iep.evaluation.psychoeducational: One measurement per index or subtest score. Composite and subtest scores are separate measurements.
by_document_type.iep.evaluation.speech_language: One measurement per subtest or index score; record the instrument and score type.
by_document_type.iep.evaluation.independent: Same as other evaluations. Do not judge agreement with district results; code compares them.
by_document_type.iep.notice: One school_action per action. Keep 'proposes' and 'refuses' as the decision; quote the reasons and options considered as written.
by_document_type.parent.correspondence: One parent_request per distinct request. Quote the request as written; record any response only if it is in this document.

byRecordType.present_level: Where your child is now, in words and numbers, and how it affects learning in the regular classroom.
byRecordType.goal: What the school plans for your child to learn in a year, how it will be measured, and the starting point (baseline).
byRecordType.short_term_objective: Smaller steps toward an annual goal, required when your child takes an alternate state test.
byRecordType.service: The help the school provides: what it is, how often, for how long each time, where, and from when to when.
byRecordType.accommodation: Changes to how your child learns or is tested, such as extra time. They change how, not what, your child learns.
byRecordType.placement: How much of the day your child spends with students without disabilities, and why any time is spent apart.
byRecordType.assessment_participation: How your child takes state and district tests, and any changes allowed during them.
byRecordType.transition: Plans for life after high school: training or education, work, and independent living. Required from the IEP in effect at age 16.
byRecordType.progress_entry: The school's report on how your child is doing on each goal for a period.
byRecordType.amendment_change: A change to the existing IEP made without writing a new one. The rest of the IEP stays in effect.
byRecordType.school_action: The school's written notice of something it proposes or refuses to do, and why.
byRecordType.eligibility: The decision about whether your child qualifies for special education, and under which category.

definitions.definition: How long a service runs, from its start date to its end date. Not the length of one session.
Where a service is delivered, such as the special education classroom. Different from placement.
How much of the day a child spends with peers without disabilities, and the setting overall.
The starting measurement in a goal. Not the most recent score.
A change to the existing IEP. A new IEP replaces the old one; an amendment does not.
Movement toward an annual goal as reported by the school. Not a grade.
A change in how a child learns or is tested, not in what is expected.
A change in what a child is expected to learn or demonstrate.
A free public education designed to meet the child's individual needs.
